rules.message: The row link must be a real <a href>. Middle-click, ⌘-click, copy-address, Back and the no-JS path all come from the href; a click handler re-implements them badly.
Mark the record link with data-hc-row-link. A row with several links must say which one Enter opens; guessing "the first" turns a column reorder into a behavior change.
The link must sit in a row with a stable id (id="row-<id>") — the detail's Back link returns to the list URL plus #row-<id>, and installDatagrid() lands the active cell there.
